Patagonia -- the poster child of fleece, the best fleeces on the planet, the inventors, the big Mama. What do you think of them? Today, I investigate. How good is that Retro-X High Pile? What about Synchilla? The Better Sweater? Their Gi pants? Hold onto your butts, we're going in! 

Products Shown:
- 1970s Patagonia Cardigan
- 2023 Patagonia Retro-X (Blue)
- 1988 (I think) Patagonia Retro-X
- 2000s Patagonia Retro-X
- 2006 Patagonia Rhythm Jacket
- Patagonia Point Reyes Gi Pants
- Patagonia Synchilla Fleece
- Patagonia Better Sweater 
- Patagonia Recycled Wool Shirt
- Patagonia Vintage Wool Sweater
- Patagonia 50th Anniversary Rugby Sweater
- Patagonia Micro Puff Hoody
- Not Pictured: a few more vintage Better Sweaters, a Velocity Shell, some Chouinard equipment, and my collection of increasingly insane notes on the big P. 

Anyway, goodbye.
